text: Algorithm 1 GRANOLA Layer Input: Node features \tilde{{\mathbf{H}}}_{b}^{(\ell)}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times C} , obtained from \textsc{GNN}_{\textsc{layer}}^{(\ell-1)} . Output: Normalized features per node n \in [N] and channel c \in [C] . 1: Sample random node features {\mathbf{R}}^{(\ell)}_{b}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times K} . 2: Compute {\mathbf{Z}}^{(\ell)}_{b}=\text{GNN}^{(\ell)}_{\textsc{norm}}({\mathbf{A}}_{b},\tilde{{\mathbf{H}}}_{b}^{(\ell)}\oplus{\mathbf{R}}^{(\ell)}_{b}) . 3: Compute affine parameters: \gamma^{(\ell)}_{b,n}=f_{1}^{(\ell)}(z^{(\ell)}_{b,n}),\qquad\beta^{(\ell)}_{b,n}=f_{2}^{(\ell)}(z^{(\ell)}_{b,n}) . 4: Compute mean and standard-deviation \mu_{b,n,c} and \sigma_{b,n,c} of \tilde{{\mathbf{H}}}_{b}^{(\ell)} . 5: Return \gamma^{(\ell)}_{b,n,c}\frac{\tilde{h}^{(\ell)}_{b,n,c}-\mu_{b,n,c}}{\sigma_{b,n,c}}+\beta^{(\ell)}_{b,n,c} .
